name: io.github.tonyyang0504/shein-mcp
description: SHEIN Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, set_inventory, update_listing, end_listing.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_OPEN_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: openKeyId returned by the store-authorisation call /open-api/auth/get-by-token (Store Authorization Application Manual); sent as x-lt-openKeyId.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_SIGN_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The HMAC key SHEIN's Signature Rules define as SecretKey + RandomKey: the DECRYPTED secretKey from /open-api/auth/get-by-token (it is returned AES-encrypted with your appSecretKey; decrypt it once as the authorisation manual shows) immediately followed by your random_key, e.g. '6BEC9C4B668B4B14B17EEF106BB98AE5test1'. Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_RANDOM_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The 5-character RandomKey you choose (letters/digits, e.g. 'test1'); it prefixes every x-lt-signature and must equal the last 5 characters of sign_key.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_SITE
environmentVariables.description: SHEIN sub-site for price and shelf changes, e.g. shein-us, shein-mx, shein-fr (店铺站点和币种信息 /open-api/openapi-business-backend/site/query).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Selling currency of that site for price changes, e.g. USD, MXN, EUR.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SHEIN_WAREHOUSE_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Merchant warehouse code (from `me`) for stock updates; required when the store has several warehouses.
